shortDescription: Offshore investors sold a net 4.50 billion rand ($257.77 million) worth of South African stocks last week, Johannesburg Stock Exchange data showed on Monday.Net purchases of bonds totalled 20.29 billion rand, settlement data showed.($1 = 17.4577 rand)

children: Offshore investors sold a net 4.50 billion rand ($257.77 million) worth of South African stocks last week, Johannesburg Stock Exchange data showed on Monday.
